title: hot handle covers
text: hot handle covers. I purchased these for some cast iron pans I purchased.  They work just as they should - purchased a set for my daughter too and she loved the red chile print.  They machine wash well - I lay flat to dry.  Works best for shorter handles - if you have a super long, heavy pan... might try a silicone version... in my personal opinion.
